steps.description: Execute a sharp transition of both hands from Pataka to Katakamukha mudra (Vartana) simultaneously, maintaining a low, stable Mandi (Muzhumandi) posture.
steps.rasa_expression: Raised, steady chest and a fixed, resolute gaze; shoulders held back with determination.
steps.teaching_note: The transition must be precise, occurring entirely within the single beat; utilize subtle wrist movement for the 'snap' into Katakamukha.

steps.description: Perform a powerful, controlled pivot-turn to land sharply facing the Diagonal-Left direction, remaining low in Mandi posture throughout.
steps.rasa_expression: Torso lifts slightly (Udvahitam) and then sharply resettles in the Mandi; firm, unwavering eye contact in the new direction.
steps.teaching_note: Integrate the torso and head dynamics (Shirō Bhedās) into the turn for expressive layering; ensure an immediate, clean stop without wobbling upon landing.
